Deployed bytecode is 44 bytes (sha256 d6778098) and does not match the 283-byte stock-token implementation (sha256 caced2aa) that every genuine entry in STOCKS shares. Its deepest pool is GME/GME at $612,991 created 2026-07-23T00:41:53Z, quoted directly against the real GME, with 8 of its 20 pools created in a five-hour burst that same morning. Priced $0.0000251 vs the real $21.10. Collected and tiered WATCH on 2026-09-12 (3 snapshots, 176 buyers/24h) before being flagged.
